chunks: We shall turn to their deeds and scatter them like particles of dust.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the deeds of disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Furqan highlights the concept of 'Haba' (scattered dust), illustrating how deeds lacking the light of true Tawhid and sincerity are nullified despite their outward appearance. It serves as a critical reminder that the acceptance of worship depends on the purity of intention (Ikhlas) and alignment with divine guidance, a theme central to the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings on the interplay between faith and action.
